name: Abyssal Acres
detailed_description:
Hello! I'm Lesha, the developer of this game.

Right now, you can't see gameplay in the trailer - but there isn't much of it yet. A part of the visuals has already been created - 4 circles of Hell, worker demons and their animations, 15 buildings, and various menus. The demons can walk, build, carry resources, and work in buildings. You can learn skills and unlock new buildings.

I think the demo will be limited to these features, since it'll be enough to get acquainted with the world, the idea, and the style of the game.

Below I'll place a description of the game.

Welcome!

<3

Light destroys Hell!

By the will of the Devil, your soul has been torn from eternal ice (or flame) to be reborn in the form of a demon tasked with saving Hell from the forces of light. The Devil has provided you with a small starting capital - a few demons under your command, some resources, and the remaining four circles of Hell that have not yet been destroyed, where you will need to develop the infrastructure and defense of the underground settlement.

Secen deadly sins

The underground infrastructure is organized under the signs of the seven deadly sins. Sloth is responsible for production. Lust for the emergence of new demons. Anger for combat readiness. And so on. Each sin has its own set of buildings, upgrades, and knowledge.

Despite the confrontation with the forces of light, Hell continues to be filled with new souls of sinners - the key resource of this world. You will need to extract sin from their souls, torture them to gain energy for buildings, or use their souls for demon reproduction. Sinners also possess their own sin, which affects the outcome of harvesting their souls differently.

Circles of Hell

Do you visualize the circles as straight lines? Here, they are like that. You see them from the side, but believe me, if you look from above, they are still round.

Hell is not infinite. Buildings and defenses require space. Therefore, you will need to expand deeper, unlocking new circles of Hell. The deeper you go, the darker it becomes.

Why is it rogue-like?

Gameplay is divided into cycles. First, you build - then you fight. Each cycle, the forces of light will attempt to destroy your main building - the Heart of Darkness. With each cycle, they will try harder. Your task is to fend off their attacks. If you fail, the settlement will be destroyed. However, the Devil will find you a new soul for rebirth. You will start over, but all knowledge and unlocked buildings will be preserved.

What is the plot?

At some point, the game will feature a plot. Occasionally, traders or random powerful sinners will visit the settlement. They will tell you why the Devil awakened you specifically. Additionally, sometimes the Heart of Darkness will be attacked by powerful monsters - known as righteous beings. Let's call them bosses. They will also have something to share.

short_description: Abyssal Acres is a ~pixel rogue-lite strategy game with a side view, where for some reason you need to develop a demon settlement in Hell, process the souls of sinners, defend against the attack of the forces of light and do a few other things and so on and so on...
